name: TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7
author: TRooInbound

sections.description:
TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7 transforms your Contact Form 7 submissions into powerful, actionable analytics. Get comprehensive insights into your form performance with beautiful charts, detailed reports, and advanced filtering capabilities.

🚀 Key Features

📊 Interactive Charts & Analytics
* Real-time submission charts with multiple view types
* Daily, weekly, and monthly trend analysis
* Form-specific performance metrics
* Visual data representation with Chart.js integration

📈 Comprehensive Reporting
* Analysis Data page with detailed submission listings
* Analysis Chart page with interactive visualizations
* Summary view with key statistics
* Contact-wise, Form-wise, and Field-wise analysis options

🔍 Advanced Filtering & Search
* Time period filters: Today, Last 7/30/90 Days, This Year, Last Year
* Custom date range selection
* Contact email search functionality
* Form-specific filtering
* Field-level analysis and filtering

📋 Detailed Submission Management
* Modal view for complete submission details
* Form field data display with proper formatting
* User metadata including IP address and user agent
* Submission timestamp and contact information
* Export-friendly data presentation

🔧 Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 plugin (active)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher

🎯 Why Choose TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7?

Unlike basic form plugins, TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7 provides enterprise-level analytics that help you understand your audience, optimize your forms, and make data-driven decisions. The plugin seamlessly integrates with your existing Contact Form 7 setup without requiring any configuration changes.

Privacy Policy

TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7 respects your privacy and follows WordPress privacy standards:

  • Data Collection: Only collects data that Contact Form 7 already captures (form submissions, IP addresses, timestamps)
  • Data Storage: All data is stored locally in your WordPress database
  • Data Sharing: No data is transmitted to external servers or third-party services

Technical Notes

Database Tables
The plugin creates custom database tables to efficiently store and query submission data. These tables are automatically created during plugin activation and removed during uninstallation (if you choose to delete data).

Compatibility
* WordPress 5.0+ (tested up to 6.4)
* Contact Form 7 5.0+ (all recent versions)
* PHP 7.4+ recommended (minimum 7.0)
* Modern browsers with JavaScript enabled
* Mobile responsive design
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

After Installation

  1. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and active
  2. Go to CF7 Reports in your WordPress admin menu
  3. Start viewing your Contact Form 7 submission analytics immediately

Note: The plugin automatically captures submissions from Contact Form 7 once activated. Historical data will not be available, but all new submissions will be tracked and analyzed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Contact Form 7?

Yes! TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7 is specifically designed to work with Contact Form 7. It automatically captures and analyzes all submissions from your CF7 forms.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is built with performance in mind. It uses AJAX for data loading, cached queries, and efficient database structures to ensure minimal impact on your site’s speed.

Can I see historical data from before installing the plugin?

The plugin starts tracking data from the moment it’s activated. Historical submissions made before installation will not be available in the reports.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Absolutely! TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7 is fully translation-ready and supports all WordPress internationalization standards. It includes proper text domains and is compatible with translation plugins like WPML and Polylang.

Can I export the data?

Currently, the plugin provides comprehensive viewing and filtering capabilities. Export functionality is planned for future releases.

Does it work with other form plugins?

This plugin is specifically designed for Contact Form 7. It does not currently support other form plugins like Gravity Forms or WPForms.

What data does the plugin collect?

The plugin collects standard form submission data including form fields, submission time, user IP address, email addresses, and user agent information. No personal data is stored beyond what Contact Form 7 already collects.

Is there a premium version?

Currently, this is a free plugin with full functionality. Future premium features may include advanced export options, email reporting, and integration with analytics platforms.

Can I customize the charts and reports?

The plugin includes multiple chart types (bar, line, pie, doughnut) and various filtering options. More customization options are planned for future updates.

What happens if I deactivate Contact Form 7?

If Contact Form 7 is deactivated, TRooInbound Form Insights for Contact Form 7 will show a notice and won’t collect new data, but existing reports will remain accessible.
